subject.title: [Feature]: Add Ralph Loop feature and add max iteration number into the agent configuration

question: Should proactive same-prompt repetition until an explicit STOP be a core OpenClaw agent mode, a generic plugin/harness extension point, or an external workflow?
rationale: This changes agent execution semantics and adds configuration while VISION.md simultaneously prioritizes harness capability and guards against optional heavy orchestration in core; source inspection cannot resolve that product boundary.

options.title: Define a generic extension seam
options.body: Add the minimum lifecycle and completion hooks needed for a plugin to own repeated-prompt orchestration while core retains generic safety budgets and state contracts.

options.title: Sponsor a core Ralph mode
options.body: Implement an opt-in core mode with explicit precedence, interruption, restart, transcript, and safety-budget semantics documented and tested.

options.title: Keep orchestration external
options.body: Decline a new runtime/config surface and document external workflow or skill patterns that can approximate repeated runs without core ownership.

recommendation.title: Define a generic extension seam
recommendation.body: Add the minimum lifecycle and completion hooks needed for a plugin to own repeated-prompt orchestration while core retains generic safety budgets and state contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed the item’s product boundary and have recent adjacent agent/config history.
